senses.gloss: to make ready, designate.—Part. pass. מְעוּתָּד, pl. מְעוּתָּדִים, מְעוּתָּדִין.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:21">Num. R. s. 18</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 15:28">Job XV, 28</cite>) <he>ולמי הן מע׳ וכ׳</he> and for whom were they (the treasures) designated? For those who were to emigrate (from Egypt) &c.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 264:1">Yalk. Ex. 264</cite>; Mekh. B’shall., ʿĂmal., s. 1 (ref. to <he>נצב</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 17:9">Ex. XVII, 9</cite>) <he>מחר נהא מעו׳ ועומדים וכ׳</he> (not <he>מעתד׳</he>) to-morrow let us be ready (for battle), and stand on the top of the hill; <he>נגזור תענית ונהא מעו׳ על מעשה אבות</he> let us appoint a fast and be ready (for prayer and meditation) on the merits of the fathers.
